slides.texte_overlay:
habits of people who never
seem stressed

they leave early

they leave ten minutes earlier than they need to, every time. never rushing removes a huge amount of daily stress that most people think is just normal life.

they say no kindly

they turn down what they don't have time for, politely and without long excuses. a calendar with real breathing room is the quiet secret behind most calm people you know.

they learn for fun

they spend 5 minutes a day learning something unrelated to work: a myth, the stars, an old painting. a mind with somewhere pleasant to go stays calmer under pressure.
slides.texte_sophia:
they learn for fun

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something unrelated to work: a myth, the stars, an old painting. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and it keeps me calmer under pressure.

slides.texte_overlay:
they write it down

they put every task and worry on paper instead of carrying it in their head. a brain that doesn't have to remember everything finally has room to breathe and relax.

they move every day

they walk, stretch or train every single day, even briefly. moving your body burns off the stress and tension that thinking alone can never fully get rid of.
